page.overview:
What is Lickilicky?

Lickilicky is a large, pink Pokémon. It has a long tongue and a backwards curl upon its head. On each of its stubby arms is a small claw. Lickilicky also has a long tail. It has a white mark similar to a bib and three yellow marks that look like waves.

Lickilicky prefers using its dexterous tongue to catch prey and pick anything up even as tiny as a pea. It competes with its kind to determine who can stretch the longest tongue. However, relying on its tongue has resulted in its fingers and hands being less coordinated and more clumsy.

Lickilicky can stretch its tongue to a long distance in order to reach its prey. Its saliva has an immobilizing effect that will cause itch and paralysis, so it can dissolve everything it touches with it touches.

Lickilicky evolves from Lickitung if leveled up while knowing the move Rollout.
